title: SampleSpace
author: DeepBuild
description: SampleSpace(width, height) with divide_horizontally(divisions) as a rect@1 split into one rect@1 per share, top to bottom, each share its probability of the height. a unit is the frame's short side ÷ 8 in u (fw, fh), so the frame is 14.22 × 8 units at 16:9; y flips and the origin moves to the frame's center; radians become degrees; a stroke width w becomes w × unit ÷ 100 u; font_size f is an em of f ÷ 96 units.

divisions.about: divide_horizontally: each share's probability, top to bottom

colors.about: each share's palette name, in turn

stroke_width.about: the outline width, w × unit ÷ 100 u

refuses.use_vectorized: Leave it out: every math@1 shape is a path the renderer strokes and fills on its own.
refuses.sheen_factor: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.sheen_direction: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.background_stroke_width: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.background_stroke_color: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.joint_type: Leave it out: paths join by the look's line style.
refuses.cap_style: Leave it out: paths cap by the look's line style.
refuses.shade_in_3d: Leave it out: 2D shapes draw flat; for a lit shape use math.surface.
